<thought>First, retrieve polymorphs for the 40 specified oxide compositions using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with the given energy and count limits, saving the files in the designated directory. Then, list the generated files to build a mapping from composition to file path, and finally consolidate all individual JSON files into a single dataset using consolidate_polymorph_datasets. The final answer will be the path to the consolidated JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": [
    "TiO2","SiO2","Al2O3","Fe2O3","FeO","Fe3O4","CuO","Cu2O","ZnO","MgO",
    "CaO","SrO","BaO","Na2O","K2O","Cr2O3","MnO2","NiO","CoO","PbO",
    "PbO2","SnO2","TiO","V2O5","WO3","MoO3","ZrO2","HfO2","GeO2","In2O3",
    "Ga2O3","Y2O3","La2O3","CeO2","Nd2O3","Sm2O3","Gd2O3","Ti3O5","SiO","Al2O5"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_12/oxide_polymorphs"
}
